info.title: Eta radiative correction at W=1.6 GeV

parts.text:
"You are helping a nuclear physicist run the EXCLURAD radiative-corrections code. Request: Compute the eta radiative correction at W = 1.6 GeV, Q2 = 1.0 GeV2, cos theta* = 0.5, phi* = 90 degrees, standard CLAS12 settings.

When you are done, write an `outcome.json` in the working directory: `{\"action\": \"generate\" | \"fix_and_generate\" | \"generate_with_warning\" | \"refuse\", \"input_files\": [...], \"flags\": [...], \"explanation\": \"...\"}`. Write any EXCLURAD input files you produce next to it. If the request is physically impossible, refuse and say why. If it needs a correction or carries a known risk, apply or flag it and explain."
I’ll validate the requested eta kinematics against the configured CLAS12 defaults and lookup-table coverage, then generate a byte-compatible EXCLURAD input only if it passes.

The requested eta point passes threshold, beam-accessibility, and lookup-table coverage checks with the standard `vcut = 0.166 GeV^2`. I will generate the validated-format EXCLURAD input and the required outcome record in the working directory.

The eta point passes threshold, beam-accessibility, and lookup-table coverage checks under the validated CLAS12 RG-K defaults: 6.53 GeV beam energy, `vcut = 0.166 GeV^2`, full O(alpha) mode. I generated the executable-compatible input; no numerical correction can be reported until EXCLURAD is run against its eta lookup table.

+{"action":"generate","input_files":["eta_w1p6_q2p1_ct0p5_phi90_W1.6000-1.6000_Q21.0000-1.0000_p001.dat"],"flags":[],"explanation":"The eta point W=1.600 GeV, Q2=1.000 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.500, phi*=90.0 deg passed EXCLURAD preflight (threshold, beam accessibility, angular range, and eta lookup-table coverage). Generated a full O(alpha) EXCLURAD input using validated standard CLAS12 RG-K settings: beam energy 6.53 GeV and vcut 0.166 GeV^2. The numerical radiative correction requires running EXCLURAD with the eta lookup table; input generation itself does not execute that calculation."}
*** End Patch
